overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('License info : Object'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; added the documented Object return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns an object with detailed information about the active 4D license (name, key, licenseNumber, version, expirationDate, per-product rights, etc.), reloading the license files from disk first.

constraints: Returns a Null object if executed on a 4D application that does not locally use a license (e.g. 4D remote).
